name: Ame Omoi, Kimi Idaku
source:
The Death Martial Arts Tournament is a special competition where soldiers strive for recognition.
This year is the event's 20th anniversary, and there are rumours that something special is planned to commemorate it...

At the same time, in a different place Kurokawa Megi runs away from the abusive man she calls "master".
